description: This file defines and exports multiple API modules for interacting with backend endpoints, including authentication, health checks, submissions, validation, audit, and evidence APIs. It imports utility functions for request handling and audit context building.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new user via POST /api/v1/auth/register.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs in a user via POST /api/v1/auth/login.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches current user profile via GET /api/v1/auth/me.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a liveness probe via GET /health.

methods.name: ready
methods.description: Performs a readiness probe via GET /ready.

methods.name: createCompat
methods.description: Creates a submission via POST /submissions with a simplified payload.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a submission by ID via GET /api/v1/submissions/{submission_id}.

methods.name: triggerValidation
methods.description: Triggers validation run for a submission, including audit context.

methods.name: runQualityGatesCompat
methods.description: Runs quality gates for a submission via POST /submissions/{id}/quality-gates/run.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Approves or rejects a submission, including audit and signature info.

methods.name: queryEvents
methods.description: Queries audit events with optional filters.
